logical_view_rule: The canonical conjecture registry is the ordered union of base_snapshot plus ordered_generation_shards. Asset IDs are immutable and unique. Later shards may add assets or explicit state-transition records but may not silently rewrite earlier history.
conflict_rule: For an existing asset, a later explicit state-transition record may supersede current status fields only when it cites the prior asset ID/version and transition evidence. Mere duplicate asset definitions are invalid.
compaction_rule: Periodic compaction may fold shards into a new consolidated base snapshot, but only after equivalence/audit checks preserve every asset, exclusion classification, transition and provenance reference.
